messages.text: Looked up for Sarah: H15 Dual isn't buyable yet — drop date unannounced. Magic M. 40T is live at $799, 650W, about $47 a month power at 10¢.

Hey, I'm Sarah! At about ten cents the Magic M. 40T costs around $47 a month to run. It's $799, and it draws for a full block every ten minutes. Would it run on a desk, or somewhere out of the way? Tap an answer, or the mic and tell me.
Uh, it would run on... It would run on a desk.
Looked up for Sarah: On a desk it's about 50 dB in Eco — 30 TH/s at 450 W, roughly $32 a month; 40 TH/s at 650 W is the $47 setting.
Heads up: at six fifty watts it runs warm and has fans you'll hear, so it's happier in a spare room than right beside you. Is some fan noise okay?
